config.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

config.label: Directory where Transformers
config.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

config.label: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)
config.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

config.label: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results
config.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

config.label: Grouping mode for quality filtering
config.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

config.label: Maximum number of files to keep in search results
config.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.
